properties.name: Reserve outer boundary (2023 extent, as far as public files draw it)
properties.reliability: Official files joined; about 181 km² of the notified reserve has no public map and is not included.
properties.method: Union of the Forest Department's reserve file (2013 extent), its national park and sanctuary files, the Bhainsrorgarh WLS file and the whole 2023 buffer blocks drawn in the Kota district file. Holes under 0.01 km² that only appear where two files' edges miss each other are filled.

properties.name: Reserve and eco-sensitive zones, outer boundary
properties.reliability: Official files joined. Covers the reserve outline above plus both notified eco-sensitive zones, which also take in all nine village enclaves inside the Bhainsrorgarh sanctuary file and part of the unmapped 2023 buffer. Some 2023 buffer additions near Kota and in Bundi, and part of the 2023 core villages (the OpenStreetMap point for Kolpura is about 0.5 km outside), may still fall outside.
properties.method: Reserve outer boundary joined with the MHTR ESZ outer-limit file and the Bhainsrorgarh ESZ file. Holes the official files draw are kept (the 3.5 km² exclusion in the MHTR ESZ file); gaps under 0.5 km² where two files' edges miss each other are filled.

properties.name: Core 2013 (approximate)
properties.reliability: Approximate. No official file draws the core. This layer counts about 18 km² of Jawahar Sagar and Darrah buffer blocks as core and misses the 7.75 km² National Chambal core part. It also includes 6.7 km² of village holes that the reserve file leaves open (nearly all Girdharpura, which the Tiger Conservation Plan lists as a core village) and 2.6 km² around Borabas that only the Jawahar Sagar file draws.
properties.method: National park, Darrah and Jawahar Sagar files merged and used whole.

properties.name: Buffer added 2023: whole blocks a public file draws, outside the 2013 files
properties.reliability: Only the three blocks the notification adds whole (Barkheda, Rawtha, Borabas-B; 2.74 km² notified), which the Kota file draws at 1.84 km². Rawtha and Borabas-B lie almost wholly inside the 2013 files, so this layer is the other 0.92 km², nearly all Barkheda. The file draws Borabas-B at 0.50 km² against 1.38 km² notified. Part-blocks, compartments, the Bundi additions and the National Chambal piece have no public map.
properties.method: Matching blocks from the Kota district forest-block file, minus land already in the reserve, national park or sanctuary files.

properties.name: Eco-sensitive zone around MHTR (2020)
properties.reliability: Official ESZ file minus the reserve, park and sanctuary files. Notified as 0–1 km but about 5.4 km wide near Rawatbhata. Drawn around the 2013 reserve; it crosses forest blocks partly added to the buffer in 2023, and no file shows whether the added parts fall inside it. The Girdharpura village hole in the reserve file is counted as reserve, not ESZ.
properties.method: ESZ outer-limit file minus the reserve file and the national park and sanctuary files.
